The '''ZX miniature flame projector''' (also called a '''flamethrower gauntlet''') was a personal, concealed, portable incendiary weapon produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]].

When triggered, the ZX produced a cone of fire five meters long and one meter in diameter. A corded fuel line connected to a backpack canister which held enough fuel for three minutes of operation . The flamethrower itself was powered by a source not located on the wrist.

The unit was made famous by bounty hunter [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], and later, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. They housed their flame projectors on their left wrist gauntlets below their [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[Dur-24 wrist laser/Legends|Dur-24 wrist lasers]] on their [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]]. The weapon was connected to the fuel tank in their Mitrinomon [[Z-6 jetpack/Legends|Z-6 jetpacks]] with reinforced cords.

In the footsteps of Jango Fett, many [[Mandalorian Supercommando]]s and [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] had similar flamethrowers installed on their [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|armors]].
